headline: Australian Rugby Stars Focus On Future Olympic And Test Success
seoTitle: Australian Rugby Sevens and Wallabies Players Targets
metaDescription: Tia Hinds aims for Olympic gold with the Australian rugby sevens team, while James Ramm reflects on his late debut for the Wallabies at age 28.
aiSummaryBullets: Tia Hinds and the Australian women's rugby sevens team are training to win gold at the Los Angeles Olympic Games.
Australia has not secured an Olympic title in rugby sevens since the Rio Games in 2016.
James Ramm achieved his debut for the Wallabies at age 28, becoming one of the oldest players to earn a wing position.
aiContextParagraph: Rugby athletes in Australia are currently highlighting their ambitions and career trajectories as they prepare for international competition. Tia Hinds is part of the Australian rugby sevens squad that is aiming to secure a gold medal at the upcoming Los Angeles Olympic Games, following a decade-long wait for another Olympic title since their victory in 2016. Concurrently, professional rugby player James Ramm is gaining recognition for his milestone achievement with the Wallabies. After a challenging journey to the national side, Ramm made his debut on the wing at the age of 28, earning distinction as one of the oldest players to enter the team in that position. His recent promotion serves as a testament to persistence, with the player expressing hope that his path to professional rugby will provide inspiration for other late-blooming athletes in the sport.
